whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Radhika Bakery & Cake Palace,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.5★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for birthday and custom cake inquiries.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, menu showcase, aur instant home delivery inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/radhika

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Radhika Bakery team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Radhika Bakery & Cake Palace) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake booking, birthday menu showcase, and mobile-first speed for Kankarbagh customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cakes list, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
